# Implementation Plan: LLM Chat Interface

**Branch**: `001-llm-chat-interface` | **Date**: November 17, 2025 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-llm-chat-interface/spec.md`

**Note**: This document was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command and contains the complete planning output for Phases 0 and 1.

## Summary

Build a Progressive Web App (PWA) that provides a ChatGPT-like interface connecting to the Kai LLM server at http://eanserver:9000. The app will be deployed via GitHub Actions and installable on mobile home screens. Focus on minimal, clean UI with chat functionality, settings, and user info. Integration with Kai's OpenAI-compatible API (POST /v1/chat/completions) with streaming support.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: JavaScript ES2020+ / HTML5 / CSS3  
**Primary Dependencies**: None - vanilla JavaScript PWA (no framework), Service Worker API, Fetch API with SSE streaming, IndexedDB for local storage  
**Storage**: IndexedDB for conversation persistence, LocalStorage for settings/preferences  
**Testing**: Browser-based testing with Jest + @testing-library, Playwright for E2E  
**Target Platform**: Modern browsers (Chrome 90+, Safari 14+, Firefox 88+), mobile-first responsive design, PWA manifest for home screen installation  
**Project Type**: Web (PWA) - static files deployable to GitHub Pages  
**Performance Goals**: First paint <1s, streaming response starts <2s, conversation switch <500ms, smooth 60fps scrolling  
**Constraints**: Offline-capable for viewing history, <10MB total app size, minimal dependencies, works on http://eanserver:9000 local network  
**Scale/Scope**: Single user, 100+ conversations, 100+ messages per conversation, clean minimal UI without emoji

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

**Constitution Status**: Template constitution found - no specific project constraints defined yet.

**Architecture Principles Applied**:
- **Simplicity First**: Vanilla JavaScript PWA, no framework overhead
- **Progressive Enhancement**: Works offline after first load, gracefully degrades
- **Separation of Concerns**: Clear module boundaries (UI, Storage, API, State)
- **Testability**: Each module independently testable

**No Constitution Violations**: Proceeding with standard web best practices.

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
public/
├── index.html           # Main HTML entry point
├── manifest.json        # PWA manifest
├── sw.js               # Service Worker for offline support
├── icons/              # App icons (192x192, 512x512)
│   ├── icon-192.png
│   └── icon-512.png
└── assets/
    └── styles.css      # Global styles

src/
├── core/
│   ├── api.js          # Kai API client (fetch, SSE streaming)
│   ├── storage.js      # IndexedDB wrapper for conversations
│   └── state.js        # Application state management
├── models/
│   ├── conversation.js # Conversation entity
│   ├── message.js      # Message entity
│   └── settings.js     # User settings entity
├── ui/
│   ├── chat.js         # Chat interface component
│   ├── sidebar.js      # Conversation list sidebar
│   ├── settings.js     # Settings panel
│   ├── markdown.js     # Markdown rendering
│   └── components.js   # Reusable UI components
└── utils/
    ├── dom.js          # DOM helpers
    └── format.js       # Text/date formatting

tests/
├── unit/
│   ├── api.test.js
│   ├── storage.test.js
│   └── models.test.js
├── integration/
│   └── chat-flow.test.js
└── e2e/
    └── pwa.spec.js     # Playwright tests

.github/
└── workflows/
    └── deploy.yml      # GitHub Actions deployment
```

**Structure Decision**: Static PWA with vanilla JavaScript modules. No build step required - native ES modules loaded directly by browser. Service Worker handles caching and offline support. GitHub Actions deploys to GitHub Pages.
